thread:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up: alternative to credit-based batching: a market-clearing matcher that treats queued requests as short-lived bids. bids include (tenant, value_per_token, est_tokens, max_latency, affinity). run a fast greedy match each tick to pack high-utility batches.
kevin: Curious. What problem are we solving vs current credit allocator?
maria: Main goal is better packing/utilization during mixed workload — improve GPU occupancy without manual tenant tuning. also allow tenant-level utility weighting.
nate: Scoring sketch: utility = value_per_token * est_tokens - alpha * max(0, est_latency - slo_ms). alpha per-tier. simple and tunable.
alice: Implementation constraints: matching loop must be single-threaded on a pinned core and cost <1ms p95. otherwise fallback to safe allocator.
carol: Cache affinity matters. bids need warm/cold tags so the matcher prefers coalescing similar prefixes to avoid kvcache churn.
kevin: Preemption rule? never evict in-flight GPU work. only preempt waiting groups. cap preemptions/sec to avoid thrash.
maria: Rollout: opt-in per-pool, per-tenant flag. safety toggles: match-latency threshold, auto-rollback if p99 increases, and tenant opt-out header.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: market-match-v1 to staging pool at 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z
nate: Fairness: include a min-allocation floor and per-tenant bid-rate cap. add a stability/hysteresis term to avoid flip-flop winners.
alice: Sim plan: synthetic mixes (short latency-sensitive + long background + bursty high-value) + adversarial bidders. measure p50/p95/p99 latencies, gpu occupancy, token-cost.
carol: Telemetry: emit match_latency_ms, matched_utility, displaced_count, affinity_mix, fairness_score. sample 1% of match decisions with reasoning.
maria: Prototype owners: nate+alice build sim & prototype for 2w, carol provides telemetry, kevin wires canary flags. I'll write a short appendix enumerating safety invariants.
kevin: +1. schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to align on metrics and rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
